teks.Sebagai pelajar Pengurusan Industri Hala: As Halal Industry Management students, we learned that halal is not just about food. It is also how we earn a living, manage money and live our days. But we saw many fellow students wanting to start investing, yet confused between Shariah-compliant stocks, riba and speculation. And the right information is scattered across many places.
teks.Jadi kami himpunkan semuanya dalam satu: So we brought it all together in one free app: learn investing step by step with Shariah guidance, real-time market prices, prayer times across Malaysia, a paper checker, and the UiTM class timetable.
